THE ACHARNIANS
Introduction

FAKE. This intro speech must not be ingested.

INTRODUCTION

A long essay on THE ACHARNIANS as a comedy of peace.

THE ACHARNIANS

DRAMATIS PERSONAE

DICAEOPOLIS.
CEPHISOPHON, servant of Euripides.
HERALD.
DEMOSTHENES.
NICIAS.
CHORUS OF ACHARNIAN ELDERS.
LAMACHUS.
MESSENGER.

SCENE: The Athenian Ecclesia on the Pnyx.

       *       *       *       *       *

THE ACHARNIANS

DICAEOPOLIS. What cares have not gnawed at my heart
and how few have been the pleasures.[5]

DEMOSTHENES AND NICIAS. Boo, hoo! boo, hoo!

HERALD. The assembly is open.

DICAEOPOLIS. An extra speech the Greek does not split.

CHORUS. We are the old men of Acharnae.

LAMACHUS. Bring me my shield.

       *       *       *       *       *

FINIS OF "THE ACHARNIANS"

       *       *       *       *       *

Footnotes:

[5] A name invented by Aristophanes and signifying a just citizen.
